latest.title: IR Goggles & CWIS Balance Hotfix
latest.summary: Two key balance changes have been deployed. No client download or downtime required.

details: IR Rangefinders will be disabled in the vendor within the next 12 hours.
They will return in Season 02 and require batteries to operate.
Developer sentiment agrees they were too overpowered in their current state.
CWIS now destroys the Havoc in ~6 seconds instead of ~12.
This corrects an over‑nerf introduced in the previous patch.
Hotfix applied immediately across all regions.
Changes will apply automatically after regional restarts.
